summary: Master the art of investment banking with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights into operations and strategies to boost your career potential.
lede: Investment banking operations training is for trade support analysts and middle-office managers who oversee accurate transaction processing and controls. It develops practical skills in trade capture, cash and position reconciliation, settlement exception handling, derivatives lifecycle controls, and operational risk reporting through structured exercises and spreadsheet-based analysis.
audienceIntro: This investment banking operations course suits professionals who support securities, financing, derivatives, advisory, and capital markets transactions. It starts with foundation concepts and progresses to intermediate operational analysis, making it suitable for professionals moving into broader control, oversight, or transaction-support responsibilities.
prerequisites: No formal banking qualification is required. You should have basic familiarity with financial markets, transaction processing, or business operations. Prior exposure to securities, derivatives, treasury, or investment banking workflows will help but is not essential. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted exception monitoring, FpML, BCBS 239, and ISO 20022 are taught at conceptual and operational application levels rather than technical engineering depth.
